edges.reason: transfer() forwards the untrusted caller as the _from argument of transferFrom
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether allowance must be spent
msg.sender keys allowance[msg.sender][_spender] written by approve()
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall entry point
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard of init()
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard of batchSend()
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard of setTradeAddress()
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to it
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender to ERC20 entry points
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
the _from argument selects the allowance and balance slots debited by transferFrom
the _to argument selects the balance slot credited by transferFrom
the _value argument drives the allowance and balance arithmetic of transferFrom
_from is passed into the ensure() whitelist and condition check
_to is passed into ensure() where it is compared against owner
_value is passed into ensure() and forwarded to condition()
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
transferFrom performs the raw allowance subtraction without SafeMath
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without overflow protection
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without overflow protection
allowance storage slot is read for the guard and then decremented
balanceOf[_from] storage slot is read then decremented
balanceOf[_to] storage slot is incremented
user supplied _value is subtracted from the stored allowance
user supplied _value is subtracted from the sender balance
user supplied _value is added to the recipient balance
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted addresses
owner is compared with _from/_to to bypass all sale conditions
tradeAddress is compared with _from as a whitelisted sender
canSale[_from] can whitelist an arbitrary sender and skip condition()
the constant UNI router address is compared with _from
pairFor() is invoked inside ensure() to derive the checked pair address
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) with caller supplied target and calldata
parameter a is the target of the arbitrary delegatecall
parameter b is the calldata executed through delegatecall
arbitrary delegatecall runs foreign code with this contract storage and can overwrite owner
init() writes the derived _minSale value
init() writes the derived _maxSale value
init() writes _saleNum directly from the parameter
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum
token parameter is scaled by 10**decimals to build _minSale
maxToken parameter is scaled by 10**decimals to build _maxSale
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication
batchSend performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath
batchSend performs balanceOf[_to] += _value for every recipient without SafeMath
_tos.length is a multiplier of the unchecked total computation
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation
_value contributes to the debit applied to the caller balance
_value is the amount credited to each recipient
caller balance slot is read and decremented in batchSend
recipient balance slots are incremented in batchSend
the recipient array drives the batchSend loop iteration count
the per-recipient amount drives all batchSend accounting
the computed total local is subtracted from the caller balance
loop index i controls iteration of the batchSend payout loop
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot
the addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress value
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply
constructor initialises the name string
constructor initialises the symbol string
constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router
_name constructor parameter is stored into name
_symbol constructor parameter is stored into symbol
_supply constructor parameter determines totalSupply and the initial balance
pairFor() return value is assigned to the _UNI local
the _UNI local is compared against _from inside ensure()
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to track sales

ERC20.transferFrom delegates to _transfer(sender,recipient,amount)
ERC20.transferFrom spends the allowance through _approve
ERC20.approve delegates to _approve(_msgSender(),spender,amount)
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping
_mint credits _balances[account]
_mint increases _totalSupply
_burn debits _balances[account]
_burn decreases _totalSupply
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
ERC20.transfer resolves the caller via _msgSender()
ERC20.approve resolves the owner via _msgSender()
ERC20.transferFrom resolves the spender via _msgSender()
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender
callOptionalReturn requires address(token).isContract() before calling out
callOptionalReturn performs a raw external call on a user supplied token contract
the low-level external token call can re-enter the calling contract before state is finalised
_to parameter of transfer() determines the credited recipient
_value parameter of transfer() determines the transferred amount
_to is forwarded into the transferFrom call made by transfer()
_value is forwarded into the transferFrom call made by transfer()
